title: H8 rebase: rebase task/T-0386 (the whole H8 chain) onto goal/T-0353, resolving the tests/test_bus.py conflict by keeping H1's tests and the H8 tests together under the BusSandbox base class; full gate green (merge conflict on T-0386)
spec:
STEP 0: this worktree is cut from task/T-0386 (H8 chain: f43c354, 0751d53, a25898a, bf8898c, 80e7b0d over base 2ca1517). Rebase it onto goal/T-0353 (head 68ff495, which now carries H1, H5a, H6 and H2). The daemon's merge reported rebase_conflict in exactly one file: tests/test_bus.py, where H1 (T-0356, T-0370) added test_log_run_carries_decision_identity_and_versions and test_policy_version_stable_until_prompt_or_pool_changes inside class Bus and the H8 chain changed the same region (new event tests, then T-0386's BusSandbox base class and tearDown).
Steps: git fetch is not needed (local branches); run git rebase goal/T-0353 in this worktree; for each conflict in tests/test_bus.py keep both sides: every test from goal/T-0353 (H1's two tests and anything else there) and every test from the H8 chain, all under the BusSandbox base class with its tearDown; keep every other file's conflict-free result. Do not drop, rename or weaken any test. After the rebase the branch history must contain the five H8 commits re-applied on top of 68ff495 (git log --oneline shows 68ff495 below them); no merge commit. Then run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0 (whole suite) and confirm python -m unittest tests.test_cli tests.test_daemon exits 0 as well. If the rebase produces conflicts outside tests/test_bus.py, resolve them keeping both intents and list them in the report. Nothing else changes. The rebase itself is the commit; if you add a resolution fix, commit it with the task id. Report the new head sha, the list of resolved files and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 68ff495 (goal/T-0353 head) below the five re-applied H8 commits and no merge commit

tests/test_bus.py contains both H1 tests (test_log_run_carries_decision_identity_and_versions, test_policy_version_stable_until_prompt_or_pool_changes) and the H8 tests (test_events_role_filter_keeps_seq_and_cursor, test_events_truncated_flag_and_next_since, test_events_filtered_page_never_exceeds_next_since) under the BusSandbox base class
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
